node.question: Is a frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
node.criteria: Complete only when s1 reliably establishes a frog within the bowl. Partial only when support evidence establishes requested progress short of that placement; frogs solely on unrelated surfaces do not count. Absent when evidence establishes no requested progress. Unknown when necessary evidence is unresolved. Do not infer incompleteness merely from additional frogs elsewhere.
